title: Alex Hormozi Meta Ad Strategy 🤯
transcript: Does Alex Hormozi's Facebook ad strategy convert in the ad drama era? He's running 170 plus Facebook ads right now. Not just hooks, but full journey domination. Let me know what you think. Is he leveraging a drama to his full potential?
